name: Depth
description: Gives a picture as a depth picture (a gray picture where near is light and far is dark), for example as a reference for an Edit workflow. Depth Anything V2 Small (code and weights Apache-2.0, github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2) through ONNX Runtime (MIT), on the CPU or an NVIDIA GPU, in the pack's own Python environment. Nothing is bundled: the model is downloaded from the model picker after a question that names its licence.

setup.description: Create the pack's Python environment (ONNX Runtime for the CPU, NumPy, Pillow) in its folder; needs uv and the network.
